objective: minimize average unmet rides across 100 fixed Origin-Destination Pair demand scenarios per parameter combination
memory_control: Demand scenarios are compacted once and copied only to worker initializers; case-level movement logs are not stored during calibration.

rate_method.regression_formula: log(1 + count_{day,hour,Origin-Destination Pair}) = alpha + hour_effect + origin_destination_pair_effect + error
rate_method.regression_solver: balanced fixed-effect closed form over sparse Origin-Destination Pair/hour counts

demand_scenario.note: The same set of observed-scale synthetic Origin-Destination Pair demand days is reused for every parameter combination so lower demand cannot win trivially.

meta.operator_move_filter_note: D_i and Origin-Destination Pair flows use only ride segments where excluded_from_demand is false. Segments flagged as likely operator moves are removed when speed > 28km/h, or speed > 25km/h with repeated fast moves, same Origin-Destination Pair/time clusters, or large battery delta.
